column1: # S32 pins for the infrastructure-signature pack (spec section 8.2). Columns: id, kind, value (tab-separated).
#   alt     a line the entry's regex must match; together the lines of an entry cover every alternative of its regex, at any group
#           depth (tests/test_rule_pack_signature_pins.py deletes each alternative in turn and requires a line to stop matching).
#           Lines are SAMPLED FROM THE REGEX by a generator: a regression pin that makes an edit to a regex visible, never validation
#           of what the runtime prints (the spec's `authored` caveat applies to all of them).
#   sample  the entry's `sample` verbatim (pins authored samples, which no other check reads beyond 'matches its own regex').
#   library the entry's `library` verbatim (the dedupe examples of section 8.1 name two; this pins all).
